scripts.build: npm run build -w @sharedhouse/contracts && npm run build -w @sharedhouse/api && npm run build -w @sharedhouse/workers && npm run build -w @sharedhouse/admin-web
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run contracts:check
scripts.format: prettier --write .github apps packages scripts services infra package.json tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check .github apps packages scripts services infra package.json tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.mjs
scripts.lint: npm run build -w @sharedhouse/contracts && eslint apps/admin-web/src packages/contracts/src services/api/src services/api/test services/workers/src scripts
scripts.smoke:api: npm run build -w @sharedhouse/contracts && npm run build -w @sharedhouse/api && node scripts/smoke-auth-household.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test -w @sharedhouse/api && npm run test -w @sharedhouse/workers && npm run test -w @sharedhouse/contracts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sharedhouse/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @sharedhouse/api && npm run typecheck -w @sharedhouse/workers && npm run typecheck -w @sharedhouse/admin-web
